credentialDestination.accessTokens: Short-lived tokens obtained from the exact shop and cached in Worker memory only.

behavior: Read complete current Shopify products, publications, markets, language content, contextual prices and availability.
Include eligible active and purchasable variants, preserve six explicit product holds, and exclude unavailable or unpublished variants.
Publish a complete replacement only after every source and integrity check passes, so qualifying additions appear and removed or archived products leave the next successful replacement.
Preserve the existing good feed when a read or validation fails; retain the existing 48-hour source-age limit.
Google continues fetching the existing US source on its configured schedule. Hourly hosted generation does not imply hourly Google ingestion or approval.
livePreconditions: Owner approves creation and installation of this exact dedicated read-only app and encrypted client credentials at the named Cloudflare Worker.
Verify that the app and store meet Shopify's same-organization requirement. Stop if owner authentication, installation or organization access is required.
Verify granted scopes exactly, then complete a real collector run with the new limited credential. Do not add permissions silently or use the existing broad Admin token as a substitute.
Recheck current Worker deployment, settings, source pointer and exact reviewed implementation hashes before mutation.
Resolve and qualify the public-host HTTP403 observed during the single local GET at about21:15UTC. Do not claim Google has failed from that client response alone.
Confirm the existing account supports the proposed resources without a billing or plan change.
activationSequenceAfterApproval: Create and install the dedicated app through a supported owner-authorized Shopify flow; retain credentials only in the private credential directory until destination storage is authorized.
Read back narrow scopes and complete a fresh limited-token source collection locally without publication.
Capture the exact current deployment and settings for rollback; preserve the existing R2 pointer and feed object.
Create the isolated queue, bind the dedicated encrypted credentials, and deploy the exact reviewed package with only us-en enabled.
Observe the first successful cloud job, inspect the complete source partition and pointer, verify public feed content and source age, then verify Google processing on the existing source.
Observe a later scheduled run before calling continuous operation verified. Maintain the existing local daily agent follow-up until that proof exists.
rollback: Disable only the newly installed Merchant refresh trigger and queue consumer if the new job fails; preserve the last validated pointer.
Restore the captured prior Merchant Worker deployment and its read-only host settings after verifying the exact target.
Remove the new dedicated client bindings and revoke the new app if reverting the access change is required; never alter unrelated apps or Workers.
Do not restore an expired feed, weaken freshness checks, or replay a partial snapshot.

historicalApprovalGate.reason: Automatic approval review rejected transferring the existing Shopify Admin token to Cloudflare because the credential destination and access change were not explicitly authorized.
historicalApprovalGate.saferPreparedAlternative: Separate app with only the six named read scopes; no existing broad credential transfer.
